scope: Only existing apple, milk box and mug asset geometry; no inference, optimization, rollouts, evaluation data, grasp modifications or labels. No production changes.
case_selection: First source-order seed-0 observation group per unique object, existing inventory indices 8,16,24; second groups 12,20,28 checked for identical geometry inputs and source bindings. Not selected by observed geometry/outcome.
witness_selection: Highest area-query collision-to-visual unsigned distance, stable index tie-break; not selected by grasp quality. Rays measured on exactly these points.
geometry: Saved MJB compiled mesh vertices mapped via actual geom frames into unchanged object frame. Compare with corresponding original OBJ vertices under source XML scale/local geom frames. Use source per-part convex hulls separately; do not reapply compiler principal-axis offsets to raw OBJ.
boundary_queries: Prior v3 exposed-union centroid area-density rule, with outward probe 1e-7m and duplicate tie-breaking; varied probe size is a sensitivity diagnostic and does not change colliders.
signed_reference: Winding classification only if exact-welded visual triangle topology is closed and consistently oriented with nonzero signed volume; also report winding ambiguity and self-intersection not exhaustively tested. Unsigned distance never determines inside/outside.
ray_diagnostic: Analytic intersection of outward ray with each other convex hull. Record smallest nonnegative entry and corresponding raw-OBJ hull entry. Finite first-entry within a small distance establishes a local empty gap toward the next solid, not globally connected air, contact forces or MuJoCo collision activation.
invariants: All guards installed before model loads
Object qpos and world pose unchanged
limitations: Three unique objects from existing development inputs, not held out or proof of complete mapping accuracy.
Area density is triangle area bound, not uniform spacing; overlap removal at centroids is density dependent.
Visual topology certification does not exhaustively exclude geometric self-intersections.
Source build parameters in properties.json identify intended convex decomposition; actual builder version and prebuild raw capture are not necessarily available.
Collider local gaps alone do not establish physical access for finite hand collision geometries.
amendment_before_metrics: Repeat all three unique object boundary diagnostics at 1 mm area density, rather than only apple, to compare gap sensitivity consistently.
